req.title: Cookies domain restriction
req.statement: The system shall not include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host when responding to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should not include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host when responding to /cookies. This ensures that only relevant cookies are returned, adhering to domain restrictions. The test suite will include a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to ensure cookies with excluded domains are not returned, and a boundary test to check behavior with no cookies set.

tests.name: test_cookies_domain_restriction_positive
preconditions: A cookie with a matching domain is set.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies with a cookie having a matching domain.
expected: The response includes the cookie with the matching domain.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'test_cookie=value'})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {'cookies': {'test_cookie': 'value'}}

tests.name: test_cookies_domain_restriction_negative
preconditions: A cookie with a non-matching domain is set.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies with a cookie having a non-matching domain.
expected: The response does not include the cookie with the non-matching domain.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'other_domain_cookie=value'})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {'cookies': {}}

tests.name: test_cookies_domain_restriction_boundary
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies with no cookies set.
expected: The response includes an empty cookies object.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {'cookies': {}}
